title: WPA REV4 Global Diplomatic-Training Coverage Pass v1
completion_definition: The five target regions have completed a structured first-pass control-list and primary-source discovery audit. Completion means that the pass, search protocol and unresolved edge queue are closed for v1; it does not mean that no additional institution can ever be discovered.

control_sources.name: International Forum on Diplomatic Training (IFDT)
control_sources.role: global discovery and historical control list; IFDT reports membership/participation spanning diplomatic-training institutions from 56 countries and close to 100 institutions

control_sources.name: National ministries of foreign affairs and official institutional sites
control_sources.role: preferred primary evidence for current identity, mandate, programmes and governance

relationship_to_wave_1.rule: This pass extends Wave 1; it does not renumber or overwrite those candidate cases.

new_candidate_cases.name: Diplomatic Academy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: The Czech MFA identifies the Diplomatic Academy as responsible for developing, organising and evaluating diplomatic training, including a general junior-diplomat programme and specialised training.

new_candidate_cases.name: Akademie Auswärtiger Dienst
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: The German Federal Foreign Office identifies the Academy as responsible for education and continuing training of Foreign Service personnel and international diplomatic training.

new_candidate_cases.name: Diplomacy Academy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: The Academy conducts basic, preparatory and in-service training, international programmes, language training and diplomacy/protocol training for other public institutions.

new_candidate_cases.name: Romanian Diplomatic Institute
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: RDI defines its mission around diplomatic training, further education, research, strategic thinking and international networking in support of Romanian diplomacy.

new_candidate_cases.name: Diplomatic Academy Unit of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Cyprus government and EEAS sources identify a Diplomatic Academy of the MFA and document its role in European diplomatic training.

new_candidate_cases.name: Diplomatic Institute of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: The Moldovan MFA documented the Diplomatic Institute in 2019; REV4 requires confirmation of its current organisational form before canonical inclusion.

new_candidate_cases.name: Diplomatic Academy, Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: IFDT lists a Diplomatic Academy of Albania; current primary-source identity and programme evidence remain to be completed.

new_candidate_cases.name: Institute for Diplomatic Studies
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: The Egyptian MFA describes the Institute, active since 1966, as its principal arm for training Egyptian diplomats and running programmes for other national and foreign officials.

new_candidate_cases.name: Jordanian Diplomatic Institute
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Jordan MFA documents an institute founded in 1994 with diplomatic training, research, publication, protocol-related studies and international cooperation functions.

new_candidate_cases.name: Sheikh Soud Nasser AlSabah Kuwait Diplomatic Institute
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Kuwait MFA documents a diplomatic institute created to train and qualify diplomatic/consular personnel, organise workshops and cooperate with foreign counterparts.

new_candidate_cases.name: Prince Saud Al Faisal Institute for Diplomatic Studies
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Saudi MFA documents the Institute and its governance, strategic programmes and national diplomatic capacity-building role. Existing A005 remains a separate methodological observation and requires relationship cleanup.

new_candidate_cases.name: Moroccan Institute for Training, Research and Diplomatic Studies
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: The Moroccan MFA organisational structure lists the Moroccan Institute for Training, Research and Diplomatic Studies; historical AMED naming should be preserved as successor/alias context.

new_candidate_cases.name: Foreign Service Institute
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Iraqi MFA material identifies the Foreign Service Institute, founded in 1973, with diplomatic, language, research and professional-development functions.

new_candidate_cases.name: Omani Diplomatic Institute
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Government material explicitly assigns the Ministry responsibility for supervising and developing the Omani Diplomatic Institute; IFDT historical records also identify it.

new_candidate_cases.name: Academia Diplomática Venâncio de Moura
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Angola's Foreign Ministry lists the Venâncio de Moura Diplomatic Academy; 2026 government sources document active international academic and training events hosted there.

new_candidate_cases.name: Foreign Service Institute
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Ghana MFA's public RTI manual describes the Foreign Service Institute as providing diplomatic training, negotiation, protocol, international law, research, language/cultural training and international exchange.

new_candidate_cases.name: Devawongse Varopakarn Institute of Foreign Affairs (DVIFA)
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Thailand MFA documents DVIFA as the foreign-affairs institute responsible for diplomatic personnel development, language/standards functions and international diplomatic training.

new_candidate_cases.name: Diplomatic Academy of Vietnam (DAV)
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Vietnam MFA identifies DAV as a leading research and training institution and a cradle of diplomats and public servants, also serving as a Ministry think tank.

new_candidate_cases.name: Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute (BIDTI)
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Sri Lanka MFA reports BIDTI as its diplomatic training institute, established in 1995, conducting foreign-service induction, diplomatic-skills programmes and public lectures.

new_candidate_cases.name: Myanmar Diplomatic Academy
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Myanmar MFA documents an active Myanmar Diplomatic Academy and an eight-month Diploma in Diplomacy programme conducted in 2026.

new_candidate_cases.name: Sushma Swaraj Institute of Foreign Service (SSIFS)
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: India MEA confirms the institute established in 1986 and now named Sushma Swaraj Institute of Foreign Service, with entry, mid-career, senior, specialist and foreign-diplomat training.

new_candidate_cases.name: Institute of Foreign Affairs (IFA) Nepal
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: IFA Nepal is a semi-autonomous institution supporting the MFA through policy research, diplomatic training, knowledge management, publications and foreign-service capacity building.

new_candidate_cases.name: Academia Diplomática del Perú Javier Pérez de Cuéllar
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Peru's MFA defines the Academy as its professional training centre, the sole entry route to the Diplomatic Service and responsible for continuous professional development.

new_candidate_cases.name: Academia Diplomática Augusto Ramírez Ocampo
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Colombia's Foreign Ministry operates the Academy for diplomatic/consular career selection and training; in 2026 it also inaugurated a new knowledge centre supporting applied research and strategic analysis.

new_candidate_cases.name: Academia Diplomática Antonio J. Quevedo
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Ecuador's Foreign Ministry maintains the Diplomatic Academy; its official history records reopening and reintegration into the Ministry structure in 2019.

new_candidate_cases.name: Academia Diplomática y Consular Carlos Antonio López
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Paraguay MFA documents formal training, updating and professional-development programmes, seminars, library/language functions and institutional planning.

new_candidate_cases.name: Academia Diplomática de Chile Andrés Bello
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Chile MFA identifies ACADE as the institution responsible for preparing career diplomats; 2026 sources document its current academic year and programme activity.

new_candidate_cases.name: Instituto Artigas del Servicio Exterior (IASE)
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: Uruguay MFA defines IASE as the Diplomatic School of the Republic, responsible for entry training, continuing education, research, publications, documentation and specialised support.

new_candidate_cases.name: Academia Diplomática Boliviana Rafael Bustillo
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: IFDT records the Bolivian Diplomatic Academy Rafael Bustillo; current primary-source organisational status remains an REV4 verification task.

new_candidate_cases.name: Diplomatic training academy/institute — Costa Rica
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: IFDT records Costa Rica among cooperating Latin American diplomatic academies; exact current institutional entity must be resolved before intake.

new_candidate_cases.name: Diplomatic training academy/institute — Venezuela
new_candidate_cases.core_evidence: IFDT records Venezuela among Latin American diplomatic academies; exact current successor/name must be resolved before canonical intake.

high_priority_open_edges: remaining small-state/Western European MFA training units
DR Congo diplomatic academy current status

merge_gate: Resolve aliases, successors, branches and duplicates against REV3.
Verify at least one Tier A or Tier B source for canonical identity.
Assign peer type and group without size/prestige bias.
Only then create the next canonical Master List revision.
methodological_note: The global corpus is open to later correction and expansion. A completed coverage pass is a reproducible search-and-review milestone, not a claim of metaphysical exhaustiveness.
